title: Minecraft+
description: ✨ The ultimate modpack for modern Minecraft! ✨
body:
![Now Supports Chaos Cubed!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/275a072538b7471cf8f42dcd8b442886f77f557b.png)

![What Is Minecraft+?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7e3fe2cb8fc674de9d49232053641c09c22ccd6.png)

Minecraft+ is a modpack aimed to add every essential mod to the game without downloading them yourself!

![Advantages](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78ef0cf4f56743328939d3619e6b92fbe23f4cda.png)

> **More Performance**

> **Smoother Launch**

> **Easy To Install**

> **Voice Chat**

> **Friend System**

> **Uses Newest Version**

> **In-game Skin Changer**

> **Controller Support**

> **Emotes**

> **Chat Symbols And Fonts**

> **And More!**

![Installation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a0e2ec5907e15665ca1af8dc3c2e82090262bec.png)

Play by installing to **OR** downloading from launchers including the following:

>  [The Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app) **[(?)](https://support.modrinth.com/en/articles/8802250-modpacks-on-modrinth)**

> [Prism Launcher](https://prismlauncher.org/)

![Additions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6bc0083c2f9a315983c70433ecdb442a3d563d3.png)

> For realistic physics, get [Physics Mod](https://modrinth.com/project/Xy8aRQKS)

> For VR support get [Vivecraft](https://modrinth.com/project/wGoQDPN5)

>  To record and view clips in Minecraft get [Flashback](https://modrinth.com/project/4das1Fjq)
